integrity: The radial form is forced by equivariance and integration of the hyperbolic area equation; conformal-cylinder singular values yield the sharp minimizer inequality. The unrestricted cost follows from exact annulus moduli and an affine extremal. The singular rates are explicit expansions. Independent numerical checks are consistency checks only.
scientific_limitations: The area-constrained optimum is proved in the rotationally equivariant class with constant hyperbolic Jacobian and prescribed pointwise boundary values. The unrestricted comparison is for all orientation-preserving quasiconformal annular maps with those boundary values. No analogous optimum is claimed for non-equivariant constant-Jacobian maps. The puncture and matched-parameter limits hold only with stated fixed parameters.
title: Sharp area-constrained distortion gap on degenerating hyperbolic annuli
